discourse.title: Make Sathya And Dharma Your Steadfast Companions
discourse.excerpt: You may chant any number of names; any number of mantras; you may perform any number of yajnas and yagas. But, what ultimately remain are sathya and dharma. Follow these two. You are not separate from Me. You are all My amsas! (parts), as declared in the Bhagavad Gita.
discourse.theme: Amidst all sadhanas, what remains is Sathya and Dharma.

reflection: I do so many spiritual practices — am I missing the point? Swami's answer is disarmingly simple: chanting counts for nothing if truth and righteousness are missing. Check your two companions today — were you truthful in that conversation? Were you fair in that decision? If yes, your whole day was a sadhana.

video.title: When Truth Is Killed, Dharma Is Arrested | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Nov 23, 1994

bhajan.title: Sathya Dharma Shanti Prema Sab Ko Deejo

seva_nudge: Correct one small untruth today — keep a promise you have been postponing.
